newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar eased back to flat in late trade.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar eased back to flat in late trade.

text.p: White sugar futures edged back to flat against Monday's close in late business on Tuesday after sustained light buying earlier took them into positive territory, traders said.
The spot March contract saw a mixture of trade and commission house buying, mainly outright, which pushed values up to $305.10 at one point.

Traders continued to watch the fortunes of the raws market before it closes for a two-day holiday starting on Thursday, and said a good close by the March contract on Wednesday would be bullish for London.
"I would look for a small setback but if we do go above, and rest above 10.78 (cents/lb) basis March New York, it'll be a different kettle of fish," one trader said.
At the close March was even at $303.90 and May down $0.20 at $304.60. March traded 1,404 lots and May 289.
Paris positions climbed gently higher in an overall volume of 621 lots. March was up 70 cents at $304.40 and May up 30 cents at $304.80.
